caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden grandfather clock standing upright against a plain, off-white background. The clock case is composed of three main sections: a wide base, a middle shaft with a decorative panel, and a top section housing the clock face. The wood is rendered in shades of reddish-brown with visible wood grain details, and the panels are bordered with carved molding. The clock face is circular with Roman numerals and ornate clock hands in gold, surrounded by a decorative brass or gold-toned frame with greenish accents. The clock’s hood has a curved pediment with finials on top and additional carved detailing. No other objects are present in the image. The background is empty except for some scattered brown spots, giving the drawing an aged appearance.
title: Clock (Grandfather)
